# ChatPRD

> > ChatPRD is an AI-powered platform for product managers that automates PRD generation, provides PM coaching, and integrates with tools like Notion, Linear, Slack, and Google Drive.

Built by Claire Vo and team, ChatPRD leverages advanced AI models including GPT-4o, Claude, and o1 to help product managers streamline documentation, collaborate with teams, and improve product development workflows. The platform features specialized integrations with development tools like v0.dev, Cursor, and Replit Agent.

## Key Topics

- PRD generation and automation
- AI models: GPT-4o, Claude, o1
- Product management workflows
- Notion integration
- Linear integration
- Slack integration
- Google Drive integration
- Claire Vo (founder)
- Document versioning
- Team collaboration
- v0.dev PRD best practices
- Cursor IDE integration
- Replit Agent integration
- PM coaching and templates
- Requirements documentation
